account_population.home_state: Absent candidate home is skipped because SRC-0015 constrains permissions of home directories, not account/home existence. Existing home must be a real directory; symlink or non-directory is ERROR. Physical home identities are deduplicated.
account_population.nss_scope: Only local /etc/passwd rows are authoritative in v1; network/NSS-only accounts require a future explicitly modelled authority if brought into product scope.
account_population.rationale: SRC-0015 uses the same phrase «домашним директориям пользователей» as SRC-0014. The current product therefore reuses the already-admitted root plus normal local interactive-account selector instead of treating service-account state directories as user homes.
account_population.selector: uid==0 OR (uid>=UID_MIN AND uid!=65534), shell basename not in {nologin,false}, absolute home path
account_population.uid_min_failure: Missing, duplicate, malformed or unreadable UID_MIN authority is ERROR.

donor_disposition.adapt: Donor /home direct-directory scan is replaced by the same passwd/login.defs selector admitted for SRC-0014, so root is included and the population is not tied to /home.
donor_disposition.reject: Ownership and existence requirements are not added; SRC-0015 states only the directory permission mode.

evidence_scope: Seven privileged read-only VM runs exercised the selected account heuristic and home modes. Evidence supports implementation assumptions; observed modes do not redefine the normative value 0700 and do not extend SUPPORTED target beyond ubuntu-24.04-x86_64.

non_requirements.existence: SRC-0015 does not require creation of a home directory; an absent selected-account home path is outside the mode population.
non_requirements.ownership: Owner/group equality is evidence only and is not added to SRC-0015.
non_requirements.sensitive_files: Sensitive file modes belong to SRC-0014 and are not rechecked here.

permissions_control.comparison: For each existing selected user home directory, permission/special bits must equal 0700; this is the exact chmod 700 relation.
permissions_control.fail: VALUE/FAIL when one or more existing selected home directories have a mode other than 0700.
permissions_control.pass: VALUE/PASS when the population is fully evaluated and violations=0.
